title: YonedaRepo: build together, keep the why
format: Edited current browser captures. Captioned walkthrough without narration; not a continuous recording.

scenes.title: Private access opens the funded sandbox
captions: Enter one privately supplied reviewer key to open the funded sandbox.
The key stays out of the video, URL, command line and source tree.
Trial access and its spending limit are controlled by the workspace owner.
Use the prepared workspace to inspect the application and its recorded evidence.

scenes.title: Open the checked result without a paid run
captions: Run node tools/reviewer.mjs --checked from the repository checkout.
Node 24 is enough; the command needs no dependency installation.
Checked mode opens an existing result and does not start a paid trial.
Enter the private access key only when the command prompts for it.

scenes.title: Two Git-native forks, two scoped agents
captions: Two agents receive separate Git-native forks from the same starting revision.
Each agent has approved writable paths; capture rejects changes outside that scope.
Separate scopes let both agents work without overwriting each other’s files.
The workspace shows each agent’s task and captured contribution.

scenes.title: Timeline preserves the checked repair history
captions: Earlier failed trials stay available in run history.
This trial records an owner-approved repair after its first checked result.
Repair retains the same budget and unchanged specialist captures.
The old candidate is kept as stale; a fresh capture is independently checked.

scenes.title: Assertions, verified receipts and the manifest
captions: Agent handoffs describe what an agent says it completed; the UI labels them as assertions.
Trusted capture validates files and records an exact Git revision.
Verified task receipts show which revisions and paths entered the next stage.
An integration manifest lists the captured inputs used for assembly.

scenes.title: Inspect the exact checked candidate
captions: Open the result tied to its exact captured revision.
This historical example retains a change summary; inspect its exact source using the read-only viewer.
New Git-native captures record a bounded full patch instead of change statistics.
The checked result and published source stay separate until an owner decides.

scenes.title: Choose the checks for this project
captions: Owners can choose checks and see each command’s recorded result.
An inline npm ci check can install dependencies from the approved registry.
Optional immutable test bundles pin owner-approved tests; changes to protected tests require explicit review.
This prepared example uses owner-defined inline checks; its results do not establish arbitrary application correctness.

scenes.title: Preview in an isolated environment
captions: Open a candidate preview on an isolated origin.
Preview output is served separately from the main workspace.
Inspect the rendered project before deciding whether to publish it.
The preview stays associated with its candidate revision.

scenes.title: Trace each file to its capture receipt
captions: Read the trail as intent, tasks, captured changes, checks and decision.
File provenance links changed paths to trusted capture receipts.
Receipts show what was captured and which revision contains it.
File receipts prove captured bytes. Separate context-read receipts show delivery, not a model's understanding.

scenes.title: Open the focused graph when useful
captions: Open the graph for a visual view of connected evidence.
Focus on one run’s neighborhood to keep the view readable.
Graph pages load on demand; the readable trail remains available.
Select a record and follow its linked context when useful.

scenes.title: Review conflicts before an owner decides
captions: Review the candidate, fresh checks and repository conflicts before selection.
Disjoint changes can be integrated, then checked again against the current revision.
Overlapping changes require an owner-approved scoped resolver.
The resolver does not claim an automatic semantic merge; publication still needs an owner decision.

scenes.title: Browse paged history and active-run limits
captions: Run history loads in pages so older results remain available.
Diffs and evidence graph pages load only when opened.
The active-run cap is six simultaneous runs.
That cap applies to active work, not the total number of historical runs.
